name: Axiom Orbital Shuttle
description: A reusable orbital launch vehicle that connects Meridian 88's spaceport to low Earth orbit stations. Seats twenty passengers in pressurized comfort and launches twice weekly. The ticket price ensures that only Tier 5 elites and corporate priority cargo ever leave the atmosphere. For everyone else, orbit is as unreachable as it was two hundred years ago. The launch is visible from anywhere in the city — a pillar of fire climbing into a sky that most residents will never touch.
propulsion: Hybrid hydrogen/electric aerospike engine, orbital maneuvering thrusters
cost: Φ500,000 per seat. Cargo: Φ1,000 per kg.
autonomy: Fully autonomous with human pilot oversight
common_usage: Executive orbital transit, priority cargo to orbital stations, prestige.
story_hooks: An orbital shuttle launches with a passenger manifest that includes someone who died three months ago
The shuttle's orbital insertion window is being calculated to avoid something in low orbit that isn't on any public tracking database
